title: Manufacturing and supply chain game
author: Tribex10
selftext:
I'm having a lot of fun putting together this supply chain management game, with factory building, farming, automation, a global market economy, and infinite world with purchasable plots.

The art needs a lot of work, but the game is very playable. 

This plot is made up of three adjoining land purchases, one holding a massive tree farm, one holding a concrete plant, and one holding a set of paper mills fed by the tree farm.

Inspired by factorio, factory idle, and similar, but operating in a shared multiplayer world and economy.
